decision: Replace BRC0055G with BRC0054G as the TBCA target for the cornstarch-porridge label. This corrects the unsupported banana ingredient and aligns with the exact POF MINGAU DE MAIZENA record and historical C0054G lineage.
limitations: The source label does not establish whether the generated recipe used milk, sugar, or their amounts; the selected TBCA preparation includes whole milk and sugar.
The historical POF code C0054G is shared by several unlike porridge/product labels, so it does not prove recipe identity.
This target decision does not validate the generated ingredient list, profile eligibility, or environmental footprint attribution; those audits remain separate.
